scenario.title: Evangelion: Battle Asuka - The Crimson Detective
scenario.logline: Asuka Sohryu Langley Shikinami joins forces with a mysterious detective to unravel a conspiracy that threatens the future of humanity.
scenario.synopsis: In the aftermath of the Second Impact, NERV recruits Asuka Sohryu Langley Shikinami to pilot an Evangelion unit. While adapting to her new life, she encounters a secret society planning to exploit the power of the Angels for their own gain. To unravel this conspiracy, Asuka teams up with a mysterious detective with connections to her past.

Act1.scene: Asuka joins NERV and meets other pilots
Asuka's first mission in an Evangelion unit goes awry

Act2.scene: Asuka encounters the detective, who offers help
Asuka and the detective uncover a secret society's plan

Act3.scene: The secret society attacks NERV, Asuka and her allies fight back
Asuka confronts the leader of the secret society in an epic battle

Act4.scene: The conspiracy is unraveled, the Angels' true purpose is revealed
Asuka and her allies prepare for the next battle

Act5.scene: Final battle against a powerful Angel
Asuka and her allies secure a victory, but at a cost

Mysterious Detective.role: Ally, Asuka's partner in the investigation

scenario.visual_style: Combines detailed mecha designs with distinctive character features, inspired by classic Shonen styles.
color_palette: Crimson red, metallic silver, navy blue
scenario.music_mood: Epic orchestral score with modern electronic elements to heighten action scenes
